what: American Homes 4 Rent owns about 60,000 single-family rental houses across the American South and Midwest, and unusually it also builds new houses specifically to rent out.
customers: Families renting houses in Atlanta, Dallas, Charlotte, Nashville, Phoenix and similar metros.
money: monthly rent on the owned portfolio
moat: A development arm that builds rental houses at cost rather than buying them at market, which no other large landlord does at this scale.
risks: Several states have proposed limits on institutional ownership of single-family homes
26 times earnings for a landlord growing rents in the low single digits
opportunities: $833M of free cash flow and a 23.7% net margin
Building houses rather than buying them means adding homes below market cost
High mortgage rates keep would-be buyers renting, which supports occupancy
watch: Same-home rent growth and how many newly built houses are delivered each year.
